vne_powered_to_3000ft.notes: At sea level, never exceed speed (VNE) of 94 kt (108 mph) IAS, doors on. Reduce above sea level per Figure 2-1.

vne_above_3000ft.notes: VNE decreases with altitude per Figure 2-1 chart. E.g. at 10,000 ft DA and 0°F OAT: 83 KIAS; at 12,000 ft and 0°F OAT: 63 KIAS. No single discrete value stated for 'above 3000 ft'.

airspeed_indicator_green_arc_min.notes: No green arc minimum for airspeed indicator stated in the text provided.

airspeed_indicator_red_line.notes: Red line (VNE) on airspeed indicator: 94 KTS (108 MPH). Doors off VNE is 90 KTS IAS.

power_on_max.notes: Green arc rotor 390 to 504 RPM; upper red line rotor 504 RPM. Power-on specific upper limit not separately called out from power-off upper limit in text; 504 RPM is the upper red line.

power_on_min.notes: Lower red line rotor 390 RPM. Power-on specific minimum not separately called out from power-off minimum in text.

power_on_min_o320_variant.notes: No O-320 variant referenced in this section; engines listed are Lycoming HO-360-C1A and HIO-360-G1A.

power_off_max.notes: Maximum rotor speed limitation is 504 RPM (with power OFF), per Section 2-6.

power_off_min.notes: Minimum rotor speed limitation is 390 RPM (with power OFF), per Section 2-6.

max_gross_standard_hp.notes: Maximum Gross Weight 1750 pounds per Section 2-7. Single weight limit stated; no variant by HP.

max_gross_alpha_beta_beta_ii.notes: No alpha/beta/beta II variant weight limit referenced in this section.

min_gross.notes: No minimum gross weight stated in this section.

max_per_seat_including_baggage.notes: Placard states '600 POUNDS MAXIMUM GROSS IN CABIN'. Interpreted as maximum cabin load; no per-seat breakdown provided.

max_per_baggage_compartment.notes: Placard on instrument console glove box: '20 LBS MAX GROSS WEIGHT IN GLOVE BOX'.

min_solo_pilot_weight.notes: No minimum solo pilot weight stated in this section.

max_operating_density_altitude.notes: Takeoff/Landing limited to 8,000 ft density altitude; Enroute limited to 10,000 ft density altitude.

speed_max_continuous.notes: Maximum continuous power is 180 HP at 2700 RPM. Upper red line engine 2700 RPM.

speed_max_transient.notes: No momentary overspeed allowed; reference Lycoming Service Bulletin No. 369J.

cht_max.notes: Red line CHT 500°F. Yellow arc 450°F to 500°F. Green arc 230°F to 450°F.

oil_temp_max.notes: Red line oil temperature 245°F. Green arc 100°F to 245°F.

oil_pressure_min_idle.notes: No separate idle oil pressure minimum stated; instrument lower red line is 55 PSIG.

oil_pressure_min_flight.notes: Lower red line oil pressure 55 PSIG. Green arc 55 to 95 PSIG.

oil_pressure_max_flight.notes: Green arc upper limit 95 PSIG; upper red line is 115 PSIG.

oil_pressure_max_start_warmup.notes: Upper red line oil pressure 115 PSIG.

oil_quantity_min_takeoff.notes: No minimum oil quantity for takeoff stated in this section.

carb_air_temp_caution_range_min.notes: Carb temp yellow arc (caution) -15°C to +5°C for helicopters with carbureted engine (HO-360-C1A).

carb_air_temp_caution_range_max.notes: Carb temp yellow arc (caution) -15°C to +5°C for helicopters with carbureted engine (HO-360-C1A).

flight_restrictions.notes: Flight operation under Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) is prohibited.
Flight operation at night is limited to VFR conditions.
Night operation permitted only when landing, navigation, instrument, and anticollision lights are operable.
Solo flights are permitted from the right seat only.
Takeoff/Landing limited to 8,000 ft density altitude.
Enroute limited to 10,000 ft density altitude.
Maximum VNE with doors off is 90 kt (104 mph) IAS.
If passenger/co-pilot seat is not occupied, fasten seat belts and seat cushions (secure or remove).

flight_restrictions.item: Heater use during hover and ground operations
flight_restrictions.notes: Avoid use of heater (269A4451-101/-103, Muff-type using engine cooling air source) during hover and ground operations.
No momentary overspeed is allowed; reference Lycoming Service Bulletin No. 369J.

flight_restrictions.item: Engine idle speed with rotor disengaged
flight_restrictions.notes: With rotor disengaged, avoid engine idle speed in excess of 1600 RPM.

flight_restrictions.item: Drive shaft inspection if RPM exceeds 2000 with rotor disengaged
flight_restrictions.notes: If engine RPM exceeds 2000 RPM with rotor disengaged, inspection of drive shaft in accordance with HMI Appendix B is required before any future operation.

faa_ad_95_26_04.note: FAA AD 95-26-04 is not referenced or discussed in the pages provided. No limitations attributable to this AD were found in this section.
